 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Winnipeg Jets will look to extend their winning streak to six games Saturday afternoon when they visit the Chicago Blackhawks at United Center for a 3:30 p.m. CT puck drop.
 Winnipeg enters the contest riding a five-game winning streak, most recently dismantling the Dallas Stars 8-3 on Thursday evening. The victory featured a five-goal second period, two goals apiece from Mark Scheifele and Dawson Mercer and another strong performance from Stuart Skinner, who turned aside 30 shots.
 Photo by Terry Lee/USA Today
 Scheifele's three-point performance also brought him into a tie with Dale Hawerchuk atop the Jets/Atlanta Thrashers franchise scoring list with 929 career points. The 33-year-old centre will have an opportunity to take sole possession of the record Saturday as Winnipeg wraps up its two-game Mentors Trip.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Mercer, meanwhile, continues to produce offensively, having scored twice in consecutive games. The former New Jersey Devil will remain alongside Cole Perfetti and Brayden Yager on Winnipeg's second line, while Kyle Connor, Scheifele and Gabriel Vilardi make up the top unit.
 According to Ken Wiebe, who is travelling with the team, Winnipeg will be without Isak Rosén after the young forward was banged up against Dallas. Nino Niederreiter will draw back into the lineup alongside Cole Koepke and Morgan Barron, while Alex Iafallo, Adam Lowry and Viggo Björck remain together on the third line.
 The Jets will also be without veteran defenceman Dylan DeMelo, who suffered a lower-body injury Thursday and is considered week-to-week. Winnipeg recalled Henry Thrun from the Manitoba Moose on Friday to provide additional defensive depth, although the 25-year-old is not expected to dress against Chicago.
 Josh Morrissey, who recently returned from injury, will skate alongside Mario Ferraro on the top pairing. Dylan Samberg and Neal Pionk remain together, while Haydn Fleury draws into the lineup alongside Tyrel Bauer.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Skinner gets another start in goal as Winnipeg looks to complete a perfect Mentors Trip and continue its climb up the Western Conference standings.
 Winnipeg Jets' expected line combinations for Saturday, November 14 vs. Chicago:
 Connor-Scheifele-Vilardi
 Perfetti-Yager-Mercer
 Iafallo-Lowry-Björck
 Koepke-Barron-Niederreiter
 Morrissey-Ferraro
 Samberg-Pionk
 Fleury-Bauer
 Skinner
 Healthy Scratches: Thrun
 Injured: DeMelo, Rosén
